weapon: none (app: footwork is filmed without a sword - data/movements/*.yaml, weaponTracking: none); arms hang relaxed beside the body

clearance_check.method: per frame on the evaluated body mesh (masks off): BVH triangle overlap shin/foot vs other leg, hands/forearms vs torso and thighs; forearm penetration as in hemagen/clearance.py; foot min z vs rest sole; knee offset in front of the hip-ankle line along the foot direction; ball-of-foot slide while planted. No sword in the footwork clips, so the blade/cross/grip distances of the Zornhau check do not apply.

face_visibility_check.method: hemagen/facecheck.py (2D coverage of the eroded face polygon by the hands in front of the face; no sword)

keyframe_format: bx/by = ball of foot (torso units L, world x forward / y left), hip_x in L, angles in degrees; hip height derived from knee_ratio + hip_level (hemagen/footwork.py)

landmark_format.notes: x,y normalised image coords (0..1, y down) like MediaPipe; z = depth relative to hip centre in x-normalised units (smaller = closer to camera); visibility_gt = 0 if another surface occludes the point by >14 cm along the camera ray; left/right = the person's anatomical side. Joint landmarks are skeleton joint centres; face/heel/toe are rigid surface points on the head/foot bones.

normalisation_assumption: features computed with origin = hip centre, unit = 2D torso length (per frame), x towards facing, y up (hemagen/features.py port)
